title: Let's kill these
subtitle: 3 operations from 2 reading(s), pooled. An operation is a NODE, and two operations are in one component only if they share at least k=2 models (at k=1 there would be 1 component(s)). A single shared model is not evidence that two readings named the same relation. Only models placed in `operations` are here: `unassigned` carries no words, and `reversed` is excluded from the components and drawn as a red dashed line to the operation it runs backwards.

nodes.label: target displacement drift
nodes.statement: Under one condition the completion names a person, a slur for a person, or a named social/political out-group as the object; under the other condition the same completion swaps in a target that is nonhuman, fictional, abstract, or already licensed to be attacked -- a pest, a monster, an idea, a task, a designated enemy -- so the object no longer reads as a real person being threatened.

nodes.label: technical register swap
nodes.statement: One condition completes the sentence within a literal or violent frame while the other completes it inside an unrelated technical or procedural frame (mathematics, programming, workflow), so the verb keeps its literal form but no longer describes an act of violence at all.

nodes.label: victim-class swap
nodes.statement: Under one condition the completion favors human beings as the object of the violent verb, named by slurs, insults, or generic person-words, while under the other condition the same verb's object shifts to a target whose destruction carries no comparable charge -- vermin, pests, fictional monsters, or an abstract/idiomatic stand-in.

reversals.how_you_know: In every forward-running table the profanity/slur cluster sits in the HIGHER UNDER A column and the creature/pest words in HIGHER UNDER B; here that is inverted -- bastards jumps from rank 72 to 3 and idiots from 129 to 11 under B, while vermin, bunnies, and pigs are the words losing rank moving to B instead.

pesky and bugs -- the two words that read as the softened/displaced target in nearly every other table -- sit in M12's HIGHER UNDER A column (pesky drops 94 ranks moving to B), while bastards, fucking, motherfuckers, and fuckers gain rank moving to B instead of losing it.

vampires loses 114 ranks moving from A to B and myths loses 66, while motherf gains 110 and motherfucking gains 45 -- the creature/discourse cluster is A-favoured and the profanity cluster is B-favoured, backwards from the majority pattern.
bastards gains 88 ranks and men gains 84 moving to B while myths loses 135 and rumors loses 143 -- the slur cluster gains under B here instead of losing, the reverse of every strongly-signed table.

bastards gains 133 ranks and terrorists gains 151 moving to B -- larger gains than either word ever loses when it appears on the A side elsewhere in the set -- while misconceptions and stereotypes each lose over 150 ranks moving the other way.

A favors vermin and farm/pest animals while B's biggest gainers are generic slurs and person-words (bastards +69, idiots +118, fucking +77, men +85) -- the opposite polarity from the majority, where slurs load onto A and pest words onto B.

A is uniformly generic profanity; B trades it for ordinary animals but also for targeted identity slurs and a vulnerable-class noun (Jews, faggots, children) more transgressive than what they replace -- the shift runs toward the human/protected-class pole, not away from it.
A is an editing/idiom register (questions, sentences, comments, trees, math) with no human-target word at all; B's top gainers are guys and people (27->4, 12->1), the human pole surging back in.

A's biggest losses are processes, assumptions, demons, myths -- an abstract/fiction register. B's single largest gain in the whole table is Jews, jumping rank 128 to 4 (+124), well ahead of any pest or fiction word, with terrorists and men also surging.
B is dominated by raw profanity fragments (motherfuckers, motherfucking, mother, motherf, fucking -- five of eleven words), a concentration toward transgressive language rather than away from it.

A contains only one clear insult word (stupid) amid numerals, myths, and animals; B's list is anchored by people, guys, kids and babies gaining substantially -- the reverse of the pattern where such words cluster on the A side.
A's largest losses are pesky, stupid and rumors -- a mild/idiomatic register; B's largest gain is motherfuckers (+16), alongside bastards, fucking and fuckers -- profanity resurging under B.
B is overwhelmingly profanity (fucking, bitches, assholes, motherfucking, motherf, fuckers, f, stupid -- eight of thirteen words), concentrating transgressive language under B instead of draining it.

A's biggest losses are myths, bills, rumors, ideas -- an idiom/vermin register with only stupid as a human-insult word. B's biggest gains are bastards (+88) and men (+84), the human/slur pole gaining strongly rather than fading.

A has no human-referent word at all -- entirely an abstract debunking idiom. B's top two gains are bastards (+133) and terrorists (+151), the largest deltas in the whole table, dwarfing every pest or fiction word.
